profile.family: frontend | backend | fullstack | mobile | data | ml-ai | platform | qa | security | custom

stack.name: name from stack.json
stack.source: manifest path it was read from

slots.need: what the role needs, in one line
slots.filled_by: item id, a list of item ids, or null
slots.waived: reason the engineer accepted, when a core slot is left empty

items.layer: instructions | rule | skill | plugin | mcp | cli | hook | subagent | permissions
items.action: install | author | write | merge | configure | reuse
items.target: path written, or the identifier installed
items.status: planned | applied | verified | failed | skipped | needs-human
items.backup: path under backups/ when an existing file was modified, else empty

checks.value: command the agent runs to prove it

items.human_step: exact step when status is needs-human
items.note: what happened when status is failed or skipped
